name: Abbe Blacker
notes: Runs Minneapolis Mah Jongg Club; 4-part beginner series and open play. Club storefront at 3942 Market St, Edina.

name: Tarri Levine
notes: Recognized instructor and tournament director; teaches American Style Mah Jongg in Minneapolis/New Brighton and elsewhere in Minnesota.

name: Mahj Happy
notes: American Mahjong lessons, private group events and open play across Minneapolis and the Twin Cities. Beginner lessons about two hours; $60/person.

name: Jennifer / Mahj Nest
notes: American Mahjong Mahj 101 and in-home private lessons across the southwest Twin Cities. In-home price is $40/person for a group of 4 or $30/person for a group of 8.

name: Paul Fisher & Katie O'Kane / Northstar Mahjong Society
notes: American Mahjong teaching team offering public classes, guided open play and private events throughout the Twin Cities.

name: Lisa-Marie Stienessen / Let's Learn Mahjong!
notes: Twin Cities instructor offering public group lessons and private events. City of Fridley and local brewery pages identify upcoming American Mahjong beginner classes.
